note: The collection classes are chosen around the current analog front end, not around the product. They are large, unsubtle motions picked so they clear the noise floor; a shipping command set wants gestures that separate from ordinary skiing motion, which these do not. Revisit the set once the front end is fixed. Every class here is performable with a fist closed on a pole. Arrows are a plan view of the pole tip seen from above, with forward meaning down-track; the lateral pair is written for the right arm. This file is read only at startup, so a change here needs a backend restart.

motion.hint: rotate your forearm out so the pole tip swings away from you
rotate your forearm in so the pole tip swings toward you
cock your wrist toward the thumb so the pole tip swings down-track
drop your wrist toward the pinky so the pole tip swings behind you
